## 2026-05-19

### Impact

- Fixes a bug where running an action (e.g. a refresh) against a linked-but-unauthenticated connector would fail with `unknown-failure`. Users will now be correctly prompted to re-authenticate via TrueAuth, after which the action completes successfully.

### Changes

- Route action flows through an overlay attached to the host activity so injected TrueAuth webviews can be presented when a connector needs to re-authenticate

### Products

- Manage

### Requirements

#### Latest

| Name       | Compatible | Build Version |
| ---------- | ---------- | ------------- |
| Kotlin     | 2.0+       | 2.1.21        |
| Gradle     | 8.7+       | 8.7           |
| AGP        | 8.6+       | 8.6.1         |
| Min SDK    | 23         | 23            |
| Target SDK | 35         | 35            |

#### Legacy (`-kotlin1.9`)

| ---------- | ---------- | ------------- |
